title: Kittens are born
creator_credit: McGraw-Hill Films, Hugh Johnston and Suzanne Johnston
brief_description: Follows a female cat from pregnancy through labour and the birth of three kittens. Emphasises the birth process and parental care immediately following birth. Suitable for upper primary level.
